roadmap.title: Start and early Trust Levels
roadmap.description: Finish the prologue and reach Trust Level 11 for the first chapters and the Curio and Requisitorium unlocks.

roadmap.title: Combat feats on easier missions
roadmap.description: On Sedition or lower, play missions and pick up the single-run combat feats, team feats and the Data Interrogation.

roadmap.title: Class challenges
roadmap.description: Play each of the four classes and finish its three challenges.

roadmap.title: High difficulty and long grinds
roadmap.description: Clear every mission type on Uprising and Heresy, string together flawless runs, and finish the long counters and Trust Levels.

achievements.description: Complete the prologue.
achievements.summary: Complete the prologue.

steps.text: The prologue starts automatically when you create a character. Play it to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Path of Trust chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Complete chapter 1 of the Path of Trust.

steps.text: Play missions to raise your Trust Level until chapter 1 completes.

achievements.description: Complete Path of Trust chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Complete chapter 2 of the Path of Trust.

steps.text: Keep playing missions to raise your Trust Level until chapter 2 completes.

achievements.description: Complete Path of Trust chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Complete chapter 3 of the Path of Trust.

steps.text: Keep playing missions to raise your Trust Level until chapter 3 completes.

achievements.description: Complete Path of Trust chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Complete chapter 4 of the Path of Trust.

steps.text: Keep playing missions to raise your Trust Level until chapter 4 completes.

achievements.description: Complete Path of Trust chapter 5.
achievements.summary: Complete chapter 5 of the Path of Trust.

steps.text: Keep playing missions to raise your Trust Level until chapter 5 completes.

achievements.description: Complete Path of Trust chapter 6.
achievements.summary: Complete chapter 6 of the Path of Trust.

guide.context: Chapter 6 completes at @mechanic{Trust Level} 30.

steps.text: Keep playing missions until one class reaches Trust Level 30.

achievements.description: Unlock your first Curio slot.
achievements.summary: Unlock your first Curio slot.

steps.text: Play missions until you reach @mechanic{Trust Level} 8.

achievements.description: Unlock access to Sire Melk's Requisitiorium.
achievements.summary: Unlock access to Sire Melk's Requisitorium.

steps.text: Play missions until you reach @mechanic{Trust Level} 11.

achievements.description: Have 2 different Classes at rank 30.
achievements.summary: Get two different classes to rank 30.

guide.context: Classes level separately. Higher difficulty missions give more XP. A quick way is to play Sedition missions and rush to the end.

steps.text: Play your first class until it reaches rank 30.
Create or choose a second class and level it to rank 30.

achievements.description: Have 4 different Classes at rank 30.
achievements.summary: Get four different classes to rank 30.

guide.context: Classes level separately. The base game has four classes: Veteran, Zealot, Psyker and Ogryn.

steps.text: Take each of the four base classes to rank 30.

achievements.description: Complete 10 missions in a row without going down on Malice difficulty or higher.
achievements.summary: Finish 10 consecutive missions on Malice difficulty or higher without being downed once.

guide.context: A Pox Hound pounce, a Mutant grab, or a Trapper catch does not count as going down. Being downed breaks the run.

steps.text: Choose a class that stays safe, such as the Veteran at range or the Ogryn for toughness.
Win 10 Malice or higher missions back to back with nobody on you going down. A mission with the Low-Intensity Engagement Zone modifier is the safest.

achievements.description: Block 600 damage in 10 seconds.
achievements.summary: Block 600 damage in 10 seconds.

guide.context: Defensive Stance does not count as blocking.

steps.text: Equip a melee weapon and hold block while a horde hits you, until you have blocked 600 damage within 10 seconds. The Ogryn's shield blocks the most.

achievements.description: Dodge 12 attacks in a row.
achievements.summary: Dodge 12 attacks in a row.

steps.text: Let a horde swarm you and keep dodging left, right or back until 12 attacks in a row have missed you. A weapon with high Mobility helps.

achievements.description: Kill 20 consecutive enemies with headshots.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies in a row with headshots.

guide.context: A Psyker's Brain Burst counts as a headshot.

steps.text: Play the Psyker and kill enemies with @mechanic{Brain Burst}.
Do not kill any enemy with a body hit until you reach 20 in a row.

achievements.description: Kill a Monstrosity in 20 seconds or less.
achievements.summary: Defeat a Monstrosity within 20 seconds.

guide.context: You cannot make a Monstrosity appear. Monstrosities are weaker on Sedition.

steps.text: Play Sedition missions until a Monstrosity spawns.
Kill it within 20 seconds of starting the fight.

achievements.description: Kill 90 enemies in less than 30 seconds.
achievements.summary: Kill 90 enemies in under 30 seconds.

guide.context: Higher difficulty or the Endless Horde modifier means bigger hordes. Poxwalkers die in one hit.

steps.text: Fight a large horde and kill 90 enemies within 30 seconds.

achievements.description: Complete 100 missions without anyone being downed.
achievements.summary: Complete 100 missions in which nobody is downed.

guide.context: Sedition is enough. You can work on this while you level other classes.

steps.text: Play missions on Sedition and keep the whole team standing until the mission ends. Repeat until you have done 100.

achievements.description: Help 100 downed Operatives back up.
achievements.summary: Help 100 downed Operatives back up.

steps.text: Pick up downed teammates during missions until you have helped 100.

achievements.description: Complete at least one of each Mission type on Uprising difficulty or higher.
achievements.summary: Finish every one of the mission types at least once on Uprising difficulty or higher.

guide.context: The mission types are Assassination, Repair, Disruption, Investigation, Strike, Espionage and Raid. The zone does not matter. The mission list rotates daily.

steps.text: Keep a list of the mission types you have finished.
Finish each missing type on Uprising or higher.

achievements.description: Complete at least one of each Mission type on Heresy difficulty or higher.
achievements.summary: Finish every one of the mission types at least once on Heresy difficulty or higher.

guide.context: The mission types are Assassination, Repair, Disruption, Investigation, Strike, Espionage and Raid. The zone does not matter. The mission list rotates daily.

steps.text: Keep a list of the mission types you have finished on Heresy or higher.
Finish each missing type on Heresy or higher.

achievements.description: Complete a Data Interrogation without an incorrect Auspex entry.
achievements.summary: Finish a Data Interrogation with no wrong Auspex entries.

steps.text: In any mission with a Data Interrogation, click the highlighted symbols in the hacking minigame without a single mistake.

achievements.description: Kill a total of 40.000 enemies.
achievements.summary: Kill 40,000 enemies in total.

guide.context: Every kill counts.

steps.text: Keep playing missions until your total kills reach 40,000.

achievements.description: Banish a Daemonhost.
achievements.summary: Banish a Daemonhost.

guide.context: A Daemonhost stays calm until you trigger it. Once triggered it kills players. Do not fight it during a horde or with special enemies nearby.

steps.text: Bring an Ogryn with a slab shield. Use Defensive Stance to block the Daemonhost's attacks.
Find a Daemonhost. They often appear in power outage missions.
Wake it, then have the team shoot it until it is banished.

achievements.description: As the Ogryn, kill a Corruptor by hitting it in the eye with your grenade box.
achievements.summary: As the Ogryn, kill a Corruptor by hitting its eye with your grenade box.

guide.context: The Corruptor only appears in Smelter Complex, Silo Cluster and Relay Station. It spawns after you destroy 3 daemonic growths.

steps.text: Play the Ogryn on one of those three missions.
Destroy 3 daemonic growths to spawn the Corruptor.
Throw your grenade box at the Corruptor's eye until it dies.

achievements.description: As the Ogryn, use Bull Rush to interrupt a Plague Ogryn's charge.
achievements.summary: As the Ogryn, stop a Plague Ogryn mid-charge by hitting it with Bull Rush.

steps.text: Play the Ogryn until a Plague Ogryn appears.
Use Bull Rush as soon as its charge animation starts.

achievements.description: As the Ogryn, knock down 60 enemies with a single Bull Rush on Malice Threat or higher.
achievements.summary: As the Ogryn, knock down 60 enemies with one Bull Rush while playing on Malice or higher.

guide.context: Big crowds make this easier: use higher difficulty and the Endless Horde modifier.

steps.text: Play the Ogryn on a Malice or higher mission and wait for a big horde.
Use one Bull Rush through the crowd until 60 enemies are knocked down.

achievements.description: As the Veteran, hit 5 enemies with a Frag Grenade explosion without it bouncing.
achievements.summary: As the Veteran, hit 5 enemies with one Frag Grenade explosion before the grenade bounces.

guide.context: The grenade must explode without bouncing. A horde that is coming is hit about 2 seconds after the throw.

steps.text: Ping a spot where a mob stands or will arrive.
Stand about 27 metres from the ping at the same height.
Look up until the enemies leave your view, then tap the grenade throw.

achievements.description: As the Veteran, hit 4 weak spots without missing a shot during a single use of Volley Fire.
achievements.summary: As the Veteran, hit 4 weak spots without missing during one use of Volley Fire.

guide.context: A Beast of Nurgle is slow and has a big weak spot on its back. With an automatic weapon, fire single shots.

steps.text: Hold right click to start Volley Fire on a target.
Hit its weak spot 4 times without a miss.

achievements.description: As the Veteran, complete a Mission on Malice Threat or higher without taking any melee damage.
achievements.summary: As the Veteran, complete a mission on Malice difficulty or higher without taking melee damage.

guide.context: Joining a mission already in progress still counts.

steps.text: Play the Veteran on a Malice or higher mission.
Do not take melee damage until the mission ends. Stay at range and let teammates take the melee.

achievements.description: As the Psyker, kill 7 enemies in 2 seconds by knocking them off a ledge with Psykinetic's Wrath.
achievements.summary: As the Psyker, knock enemies off a ledge with Psykinetic's Wrath so that 7 of them die within 2 seconds.

guide.context: Smelter Complex has a central platform with no railings at the end of the mission. Chasm Logistratum has a small bridge.

steps.text: Go to a platform or bridge with no railings.
Use Psykinetic's Wrath on a crowd at the edge so that 7 enemies fall and die within 2 seconds.

achievements.description: As the Psyker, kill a pouncing Pox Hound with Brain Burst.
achievements.summary: As the Psyker, use Brain Burst to kill a Pox Hound while it is pouncing.

guide.context: Staying far from your team can make a Pox Hound spawn.

steps.text: Play the Psyker and wait for a Pox Hound to spawn.
Use Brain Burst on it while it is leaping at you.

achievements.description: As the Psyker, kill 1 elite with a single Perils of the Warp on Malice Threat or higher.
achievements.summary: As the Psyker, kill an elite enemy with one Perils of the Warp blast on Malice difficulty or higher.

guide.context: The blast happens when your Peril gauge hits 100%.

steps.text: On a Malice or higher mission, have your team pull an elite close to you.
Let your Peril reach 100% next to the elite so the explosion kills it.

achievements.description: As the Zealot, kill a Mutant with a melee attack while dashing when using Chastise the Wicked.
achievements.summary: As the Zealot, use Chastise the Wicked to dash, and kill a Mutant with a melee hit during that dash.

guide.context: Staying far from your team can make a Mutant spawn. Lower its health first.

steps.text: Play the Zealot and wait for a Mutant to charge you.
Dodge its charge, then use Chastise the Wicked and hit it with a melee attack while dashing.

achievements.description: As the Zealot, hit an enemy sniper more than 40 metres away using a Stun Grenade.
achievements.summary: As the Zealot, hit an enemy sniper from more than 40 metres away with a Stun Grenade.

guide.context: The explosion is enough; the grenade does not need to touch the sniper. Silo Cluster has a long bridge to an elevator defence point where snipers often spawn.

steps.text: Find a sniper and ping it to check that it is more than 40 metres away.
Hold left click to aim the grenade and throw it at the sniper.

achievements.description: As the Zealot, kill 40 stunned enemies within 10 seconds on Malice Threat or higher.
achievements.summary: As the Zealot, on Malice difficulty or higher, kill 40 stunned enemies in a span of 10 seconds.

guide.context: The enemies must be stunned by your grenade.

steps.text: On a Malice or higher mission, throw your Stun Grenade into a large horde.
Kill 40 of the stunned enemies within 10 seconds.
